manifest_row.title: Surprise fossil trove hints at rapid mass extinction recovery

screening.main_topic: A fossil discovery challenging the view that marine ecosystems recovered slowly after the end-Permian mass extinction.
screening.climate_relevance: The article links the mass extinction to a period of intense global climate change, ocean acidification, and fluctuating water temperatures, but does not develop those climate-related factors further.
screening.reason: The central subject is paleontological evidence about post-extinction biodiversity and recovery. Climate change is meaningful background to the extinction event, so the text is relevant peripherally rather than as core climate coverage.
